Pakistan acting as intermediary. Note: initial 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

  • Cyber & asymmetric threats: Israeli cyber chief reports a surge in Iranian cyberattacks since the war. Houthis using calmer periods to improve missile capability.
  • Other kinetics: IDF reported retaliation after troops in southern Syria were fired upon. Pakistan reported cross-border operations on Afghanistan border (separate security dynamic).
  • Humanitarian / logistics: West Bank health system strained. International rescue teams and aid movements continue where possible.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pause announced and talks scheduled; IDF removed a large terrorist tunnel. Some reports of temporary stand-downs in Hormuz operations.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
